answer: One name, one proof, one entry: Hopbound firewood cutter pasture patent enforces it, and a patent cutters file after wood reviews is how the check runs. Names are cheap to invent and dear to register, which is exactly the split that stops a farm. A farm faces 50 separate visits, each one billed £33 at the door for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. forge is written on the receipt. tundra stays on the record. The knoll is checked, not assumed.
